visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a white t-shirt under a brown jacket with a green backpack, stands on a paved campus walkway. He gestures with both hands while speaking directly to the camera with an inquisitive expression. The background is filled with large Banyan trees casting shadows on the ground under bright, natural daylight. (2) A digital overlay of a YouTube video thumbnail titled "NTU Food Battle" appears, and the man points at it. His facial expression shifts to a humorous look of mock-disgust. Pedestrians are visible in the far background of the sunny university campus setting. (3) The man walks through the campus, pointing toward a food court building with a 7-Eleven logo. He continues to speak energetically, using expressive hand motions. The camera follows him in a walking handheld motion, capturing the brick architecture and green landscaping of the university grounds. (4) The scene transitions to the man standing in front of a shop with a large, purple-and-white soft-serve ice cream statue. He points toward the entrance. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the textures of his clothing and the surrounding wooden storefront. (5) A girl is shown operating a commercial soft-serve machine, pulling a lever to fill a cone. The man then holds a large chocolate and vanilla swirl ice cream cone close to the lens. The background shows a pink wall decorated with cartoon food graphics. (6) The man points towards a modern grey building identified by a sign as the College of Foreign Languages. In the foreground, a group of three female students poses for a selfie with a tall man in a grey hoodie. The main character looks at them with a surprised, comical expression. (7) He addresses the camera one last time, pointing his finger and gesturing towards his backpack. The setting is the same tree-lined walkway from the beginning, with the sun low in the sky, creating long shadows and warm lighting on the path.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Confrontation -> Evidence -> Recommendation -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous 'rebuttal' vlog where the creator, an alumnus of Fu Jen Catholic University, jokingly criticizes a popular video about food at National Taiwan University. He then takes the viewer on a tour of his own alma mater's food options and updated campus facilities, ultimately challenging the famous YouTuber Joeman to collaborate on a video about FJU's food court.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality vertical short-form content with a social-media-native editing style. The creator utilizes mock jealousy and nostalgia to engage his audience and promote his alma mater.
